instruction.text: Build the picture of the Maya observatory.

feedback.end: This is El Caracol, an observatory in Chichen Itza that was used by the Maya to track the planets and stars.

atoms.b: With the help of their systems of writing and maths, the Maya became excellent ((++astronomers chemists)). They recorded things such as ((++eclipses earthquakes)) and traced the movements of planets and comets across many centuries.
They also estimated the cycles of the Sun and Moon, as well as the position of groups of stars known as ((++constellations roads)).
Through their understanding of the ((++sky sea)) and the cycles of nature, the Maya developed precise calendars for religious celebrations and harvest periods.

hint.sound: A dot is equal to 1, a bar is equal to 5 and the shell is equal to 0.

end.text: This wheel of Maya numbers forms part of the Tzolk'in calendar. It had 260 days and was used to estimate important astronomical events, the duration of pregnancies and when to harvest their maize.
end.sound: This wheel of Maya numbers forms part of the solkin calendar. It had 260 days and was used to estimate important astronomical events, the duration of pregnancies, and when to harvest their maize.

instruction.text: Choose any colour and select the numbers 1, 5 and 10 on the Maya calendar.

atoms.b: The Maya Tzolk'in ((++calendar calculator)) is made up of two interlocking cycles of 13 numbers and 20 ((++glyphs graphs)). Each day would have a number and glyph assigned to it, similar to how we would say a date like the 10th of March.
atoms.sound: The Maya solkin calendar is made up of two interlocking cycles of 13 numbers and 20 glyphs. Each day would have a number and glyph assigned to it, similar to how we would say a date like the 10th of March.

atoms.b: These are the 20 glyphs and their names. They can be found in lots of ((++inscriptions magazines)) and codices.

instruction.text: Use the clues to decide the meaning of each Tzolk'in glyph.
instruction.sound: Use the clues to decide the meaning of each solkin glyph.

atoms.a: The imix glyph is associated with a large reptilian creature.
atoms.sound: The, immix, glyph is associated with a large reptilian creature.

atoms.a: The ik glyph is linked to breath, life and violence.
atoms.sound: The, ik, glyph is linked to breath, life and violence.

atoms.a: The ok glyph is believed to represent an animal that guides the night sun through the underworld.
atoms.sound: The, ock, glyph is believed to represent an animal that guides the night sun through the underworld.
